### Specialization test (rule fixed before the main run)

- Best model overall: gpt-6.1-sol. Best per family: derivative = gpt-6.1-sol, integral = gpt-6.1-sol, dimension = gpt-6.1-sol.
- Headroom H (per-family best minus best single, in hindsight): 0.0%, permutation p = 1.0.
- Split-half out-of-sample gain: mean -0.9% (2.5-97.5 percentiles over splits -3.3-0.0%).
- Rule: 1_some_family_best_differs = False, 2_permutation_p_below_0.05 = False, 3_split_half_gain_at_least_0.02 = False. **Specialized: False.**
